The "molecule below" likely is the same as in make_8_lvl1-apply_template-1 answer: that answer gave a list of two SMILES: ["CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1", "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F"] That's probably the target molecule? Actually that answer seems to be a list of two SMILES, maybe the product? So they gave a molecule (maybe a SMILES) and they wanted precursors using template from template_search-1. The answer they gave is a list of two SMILES (maybe the precursors). So now apply_template-2 wants precursors using template from template_search-2 (template 2895) to the same molecule? The "molecule below" likely same as before: maybe the product is the same? The answer from template_search-2 gave mapped_rxn and template_id 2895. The mapped_rxn shows a reaction: left side (reactants) -> product. The product side is the big SMILES: [CH3:1][C:2]([CH3:3])([CH3:4])[O:5][C:6](=[O:7])[N:8]1[CH2:9][CH2:10][N:11]([c:12]2[cH:13][c:14]([NH2:15])[cH:16][c:17]3[c:18]2[O:19][C:20]2([CH2:21][CH2:22][CH2:23]2)[CH2:24][CH2:25]3)[CH2:26][CH2:27]1

That product SMILES corresponds to the first SMILES in previous answer? Let's compare: previous answer first SMILES: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". That is t-butoxy carbonyl (Boc) attached to piperazine etc. The product SMILES from mapped_rxn seems similar: t-butyl (C(CH3)3) O C(=O) N1CCN(...). Yes matches. So the product is that first SMILES. The second SMILES in previous answer is "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F" which is maybe another product? Actually the mapped_rxn only shows one product (the big SMILES). The second SMILES maybe is another product from a different template? Not relevant.

Thus we need to apply template 2895 to the molecule (product) to get precursors. Use apply_template tool with molecule SMILES = the product SMILES (first one) and template_id = "template_2895"? The template ID format maybe "template_2895". The get_template expects IDs like "template_123". So we need to use apply_template with template_id "template_2895". Let's try.
